description: Step 1 - RSFC profile + cohort-avg + Schaefer init prior + spatial radius mask. Variant-invariant, mode-invariant.
source_note: `source` fields name the file owning the field's authoritative default. Line numbers are intentionally omitted — they drift on every reformat and the file/symbol name is the stable contract.
range_policy: advisory by default — `min`/`max` fields are UI hints documenting the values authors have validated; the parser/validator enforces only positivity (numeric fields), finiteness (float fields: NaN and Infinity are refused) and enum membership (enum fields). Out-of-range values that are positive and finite are accepted at parse time. ENTRY-LEVEL EXCEPTION: `step1.threshold` IS hard-enforced to [0, 1] at parse time — a top-fraction outside that range is not a tuning question (FC binarization expects a fraction), so its `min` / `max` are part of the contract, not UI advice. See the per-entry `notes` field for the exception flag.
exclusion_criterion: Internal kernel-precision dtypes are intentionally NOT exposed in step1 even though they have function-signature defaults. Specifically: `run_generate_profiles.profile_dtype_reduce` (pinned at np.float32). Both step-1 backends compute profiles in fp32 and raise on any other value, and the on-disk profile is bit-packed uint8 whatever the reduction dtype, so it is not a tuning knob. The runner's default remains authoritative for it.

entries.description: Top-fraction threshold for FC profile binarization.
entries.notes: Range [0, 1] is HARD-ENFORCED at parse time (`_validate_step1`); see the section-level `range_policy` exception clause. A value outside this range is meaningless for top-fraction binarization.
Only '0' is implemented; other values raise NotImplementedError at generate_profiles/profiles.py.

entries.description: ini_params reduction (demean / normalize / matmul / sum) precision.
entries.notes: backend_step1='gpu' requires 'float64' (the GPU ini_params kernels reduce in fp64); 'float32' with backend_step1='gpu' is rejected at parse time. Use backend_step1='cpu' for a float32 reduction.

entries.description: Spatial radius mask geodesic radius (CBIG canonical=30 mm).
entries.notes: Directly bounds step3 spatial prior reachability.
